hintroom.level5.ashgate: The hourglass lever is far from the portcullis: gather in front, one hero flips it.
hintroom.level5.bellows: Two heroes push the block to the socket. The green hero must land 5 killing blows.
hintroom.level5.blindforge: Dark room: refuel your torch at the braziers. Each hero lights their own colored brazier.
hintroom.level5.cinderpit: The pyromancer keeps his distance and summons wisps. Use the pillars!
hintroom.level5.crucible: Two portcullises, two hourglasses. The red hero holds the crucible for 8 s between them.
hintroom.level5.emberhold: Your own key, your own door. The pyromancer waits in the arena at the far end.
hintroom.level5.forgeheart: The Forge Lord awaits. Take cover behind the pillars!
hintroom.level5.pyre: Hold the four plates together to open the door. Then the hourglass, then the great forge.
hintroom.level5.slagworks: Guardians wait behind the portcullis. The last hero gets through thanks to the near lever.
level.level5.intro.1: Beneath the mountain, the forges of the old kings have been lit again. The rock glows red.
level.level5.intro.2: A fire that is not the dawn's burns here. It chains something very ancient.
level.level5.intro.3: The smiths sealed the passages with hourglasses: take turns at the lever.
level.level5.intro.4: One flips the lever, the others run, then we open the way for them. We can do that!
level.level5.intro.5: Visitors? Come in, the metal is hot. You will make excellent rivets.
level.level5.name: The Blazing Forges
level.level5.outro.1: The Forge Lord collapses on his anvil. The flames die down at once.
level.level5.outro.2: His chains give way... Beneath the forge, something empty and cold is breathing.
level.level5.outro.3: The Void is waking. Descend, my friends: the ancient shadow awaits you.
level.level5.outro.4: We're going down. But this time we're bringing gloves and a bucket of water.
objective.level5.seal: Open your door with your key
objective.level5.slayer: Land 5 killing blows at the bellows
room.level5.ashgate.name: The Vestibule of Ashes
room.level5.bellows.name: The Forge Bellows
room.level5.blindforge.name: The Blind Forge
room.level5.cinderpit.name: The Pyromancer's Pit
room.level5.crucible.name: The Crucible of Two Passages
room.level5.emberhold.name: The Keep of Embers
room.level5.forgeheart.name: The Heart of the Forge
room.level5.pyre.name: The Brazier Porch
room.level5.slagworks.name: The Slag Foundries
sign.level5.ashgate.gate: The sand lasts only 4 s. Everyone before the portcullis, then flip the far lever!
sign.level5.ashgate.hourglass: Hourglass: Action at the lever. It is far from the portcullis, which closes without sand.
sign.level5.ashgate.relay: A lever on this side: the last hero through flips it to reopen the portcullis behind.
sign.level5.bellows.block: Two heroes push the block to the socket, at the far end of the corridor.
sign.level5.bellows.guard: The galleries are full of guardians: defend the pushers!
sign.level5.bellows.hourglass: Pass the portcullis to reach the bellows: far lever, then relay, as before.
sign.level5.bellows.quota: The green hero must land 5 killing blows for their objective.
sign.level5.blindforge.braziers: Each hero lights their colored brazier. All lit: the door opens.
sign.level5.blindforge.dark: A forge without light: refuel your torch at lit braziers (Action).
sign.level5.blindforge.door: Forge door: it opens once all the colored braziers are burning.
sign.level5.blindforge.hourglass: The hourglass is played in the dark: a brazier and a torch mark the far lever.
sign.level5.cinderpit.cover: Pillars stop fireballs. Lava forgives nothing.
sign.level5.cinderpit.pyromancer: The pyromancer throws fire and novas: close in to stop him fleeing!
sign.level5.crucible.hold: Crucible: the red hero must stand here for 8 cumulated seconds for their objective.
sign.level5.crucible.hourglass: First portcullis: far lever, then relay. A second hourglass waits in the chamber.
sign.level5.crucible.second: Second portcullis: far lever, then relay, like the first. Take turns!
sign.level5.emberhold.doors: Open the door of your color (Action, key in hand). The pyromancer waits behind.
sign.level5.emberhold.keys: One key per color, one per corner of the wing. Pick up yours by walking over it.
sign.level5.emberhold.pyromancer: The pyromancer's arena: he keeps his distance and summons wisps.
sign.level5.forgeheart.warning: The Forge Lord hits hard and summons knights. Use the pillars!
sign.level5.pyre.door: The door stays open once raised. Beyond: an hourglass, then the great forge.
sign.level5.pyre.hourglass: An hourglass seals the forge. The lever is far from the portcullis: take turns!
sign.level5.pyre.plates: Each hero holds the plate of their color, all at once, to open the door.
sign.level5.slagworks.foundry: The foundry swarms with guardians. Cross the portcullis together!
sign.level5.slagworks.guard: A lever on the other side: flip it to open the portcullis for who stayed behind.
sign.level5.slagworks.hourglass: Hourglass: the lever is far from the portcullis. A relay on the far side lets the last in.
